title: सप्तविंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 327 · The gods ask Narayana about the sacrifice

summary.en: Janamejaya asks why the Lord takes the first share in sacrifices and is himself the bearer of the sacrifice. Vaishampayana tells of how the gods, led by Brahma, questioned the Lord in a great gathering and heard from him how he created creatures, and how Vyasa then praised him.
summary.kn: ಯಜ್ಞಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಭಗವಂತ ಮೊದಲ ಭಾಗ ಏಕೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಅವನೇ ಯಜ್ಞಧಾರಿ ಹೇಗೆಂದು ಜನಮೇಜಯ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನ ನೇತೃತ್ವದ ದೇವತೆಗಳು ಮಹಾಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಗವಂತನನ್ನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನಿಸಿ ಅವನು ಜೀವಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸಿದ ಬಗೆ ಕೇಳಿದರು, ವ್ಯಾಸ ಅವನನ್ನು ಸ್ತುತಿಸಿದನೆಂದು ವೈಶಂಪಾಯನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: जनमेजय पूछते हैं कि भगवान यज्ञों में प्रथम भाग क्यों लेते हैं और स्वयं यज्ञधारी कैसे हैं। वैशम्पायन बताते हैं कि ब्रह्मा के नेतृत्व में देवताओं ने महासभा में भगवान से प्रश्न किए, उनसे प्राणियों की रचना सुनी और व्यास ने उनकी स्तुति की।
summary.te: భగవంతుడు యజ్ఞాలలో మొదటి భాగం ఎందుకు తీసుకుంటాడు, ఆయనే యజ్ఞధారి ఎలా అని జనమేజయుడు అడుగుతాడు. బ్రహ్మ నాయకత్వంలో దేవతలు మహాసభలో భగవంతుని ప్రశ్నించి ఆయన జీవులను సృష్టించిన తీరు విన్నారని, వ్యాసుడు ఆయనను స్తుతించాడని వైశంపాయనుడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: இறைவன் வேள்விகளில் முதல் பங்கை ஏன் ஏற்கிறான், அவனே வேள்வியைத் தாங்குபவன் எவ்வாறு என்று ஜனமேஜயன் கேட்க, பிரம்மா தலைமையில் தேவர்கள் பெருஞ்சபையில் இறைவனை வினவி உயிர்களைப் படைத்த விதம் கேட்டதையும் வியாசர் அவனைப் புகழ்ந்ததையும் வைசம்பாயனர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: യജ്ഞങ്ങളിൽ ഭഗവാൻ ആദ്യ പങ്ക് സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നതെന്തുകൊണ്ടെന്നും, അദ്ദേഹം തന്നെ യജ്ഞത്തിന്റെ വാഹകനായിരിക്കുന്നതെന്തുകൊണ്ടെന്നും ജനമേജയൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ബ്രഹ്മാവിനെ മുൻനിർത്തി ദേവന്മാർ വലിയ സഭയിൽ ഭഗവാനോട് ചോദിച്ചതും, അദ്ദേഹം ജീവികളെ സൃഷ്ടിച്ചതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് കേട്ടതും, പിന്നീട് വ്യാസൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ സ്തുതിച്ചതും വൈശമ്പായനൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.327; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
कथं स भगवान्देवो यज्ञेष्वग्रहरः प्रभुः ।
यज्ञधारी च सततं वेदवेदाङ्गवित्तथा ॥

meaning.en: How is it that the blessed god, the lord, takes the first share in sacrifices and is ever the bearer of sacrifice, and also knows the Veda and its limbs?

verses.text:
निवृत्तं चास्थितो धर्मं क्षेमी भागवतप्रियः ।
प्रवृत्तिधर्मान्विदधे स एव भगवान्प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Established in the dharma of withdrawal, secure and dear to the devotees, the same blessed lord also ordained the dharmas of engagement.

verses.text:
कथं प्रवृत्तिधर्मेषु भागार्हा देवताः कृताः ।
कथं निवृत्तिधर्माश्च कृता व्यावृत्तबुद्धयः ॥

meaning.en: How were the gods made fit for shares within the dharmas of engagement, and how were those of withdrawal made, with their minds turned away?

verses.text:
एतं नः संशयं विप्र छिन्धि गुह्यं सनातनम् ।
त्वया नारायणकथा श्रुता वै धर्मसंहिता ॥

meaning.en: Cut this doubt of ours, brahmin, this eternal secret; for you have heard the tale of Narayana, which contains dharma.

verses.text:
इमे सब्रह्मका लोकाः ससुरासुरमानवाः ।
क्रियास्वभ्युदयोक्तासु सक्ता दृश्यन्ति सर्वशः ।
मोक्षश्चोक्तस्त्वया ब्रह्मन्निर्वाणं परमं सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: These worlds, with Brahma, gods, asuras, and men, are seen everywhere attached to the rites spoken of for prosperity; yet you, brahmin, have spoken of liberation, nirvana, the highest happiness.

verses.text:
ये च मुक्ता भवन्तीह पुण्यपापविवर्जिताः ।
ते सहस्रार्चिषं देवं प्रविशन्तीति शुश्रुमः ॥

meaning.en: We have heard that those who are liberated here, free of merit and sin, enter the god of a thousand rays.

verses.text:
अहो हि दुरनुष्ठेयो मोक्षधर्मः सनातनः ।
यं हित्वा देवताः सर्वा हव्यकव्यभुजोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: Ah, the eternal dharma of liberation is hard to practice, since the gods gave it up and became consumers of offerings to gods and ancestors.

verses.text:
किं नु ब्रह्मा च रुद्रश्च शक्रश्च बलभित्प्रभुः ।
सूर्यस्ताराधिपो वायुरग्निर्वरुण एव च ।
आकाशं जगती चैव ये च शेषा दिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: Why do Brahma, Rudra, powerful Indra, the sun, the lord of the stars, the wind, fire, Varuna, space, earth, and the remaining dwellers in heaven

verses.text:
प्रलयं न विजानन्ति आत्मनः परिनिर्मितम् ।
ततस्ते नास्थिता मार्गं ध्रुवमक्षयमव्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: not know the dissolution of what has been made for themselves? Therefore they have not taken the fixed, imperishable, unchanging path.

verses.text:
स्मृत्वा कालपरीमाणं प्रवृत्तिं ये समास्थिताः ।
दोषः कालपरीमाणे महानेष क्रियावताम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who, remembering the measure of time, adhere to engagement: this is a great fault in the measure of time for those who perform rites.

verses.text:
एतन्मे संशयं विप्र हृदि शल्यमिवार्पितम् ।
छिन्धीतिहासकथनात्परं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥

meaning.en: This doubt of mine, brahmin, is lodged in my heart like a thorn; cut it, for my curiosity is great about hearing the account.

verses.text:
कथं भागहराः प्रोक्ता देवताः क्रतुषु द्विज ।
किमर्थं चाध्वरे ब्रह्मन्निज्यन्ते त्रिदिवौकसः ॥

meaning.en: How are the gods called takers of shares in sacrifices, brahmin, and why are the dwellers in heaven worshiped in the rite?

verses.text:
ये च भागं प्रगृह्णन्ति यज्ञेषु द्विजसत्तम ।
ते यजन्तो महायज्ञैः कस्य भागं ददन्ति वै ॥

meaning.en: And those who take a share in sacrifices, best of the twice-born, when they sacrifice with great sacrifices, to whom do they give a share?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अहो गूढतमः प्रश्नस्त्वया पृष्टो जनेश्वर ।
नातप्ततपसा ह्येष नावेदविदुषा तथा ।
नापुराणविदा चापि शक्यो व्याहर्तुमञ्जसा ॥

meaning.en: Ah, king, you have asked a most hidden question. It cannot easily be answered by one whose austerity is not heated, nor by one who does not know the Veda, nor by one who does not know the Puranas.

verses.text:
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि यन्मे पृष्टः पुरा गुरुः ।
कृष्णद्वैपायनो व्यासो वेदव्यासो महानृषिः ॥

meaning.en: Now I will tell you what I asked of my teacher long ago, Krishna Dvaipayana Vyasa, the great sage and arranger of the Veda.

verses.text:
सुमन्तुर्जैमिनिश्चैव पैलश्च सुदृढव्रतः ।
अहं चतुर्थः शिष्यो वै पञ्चमश्च शुकः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: Sumantu, Jaimini, and Paila of firm vow, myself the fourth pupil, and Shuka the fifth were there.

verses.text:
एतान्समागतान्सर्वान्पञ्च शिष्यान्दमान्वितान् ।
शौचाचारसमायुक्ताञ्जितक्रोधाञ्जितेन्द्रियान् ॥

meaning.en: He taught the Vedas to these five pupils gathered together, self-controlled, endowed with purity and good conduct, with anger and senses conquered, and the Mahabharata as the fifth,

verses.text:
वेदानध्यापयामास महाभारतपञ्चमान् ।
मेरौ गिरिवरे रम्ये सिद्धचारणसेविते ॥

meaning.en: on the lovely best of mountains, Meru, frequented by siddhas and charanas.

verses.text:
तेषामभ्यस्यतां वेदान्कदाचित्संशयोऽभवत् ।
एष वै यस्त्वया पृष्टस्तेन तेषां प्रकीर्तितः ।
ततः श्रुतो मया चापि तवाख्येयोऽद्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: Once, as they studied the Vedas, a doubt arose in them. This is the very question you asked; it was explained to them by him. I heard it, and today I will tell it to you, Bharata.

verses.text:
शिष्याणां वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वाज्ञानतमोनुदः ।
पराशरसुतः श्रीमान्व्यासो वाक्यमुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his pupils' words, the radiant son of Parashara, Vyasa, dispeller of the darkness of all ignorance, spoke.

verses.text:
मया हि सुमहत्तप्तं तपः परमदारुणम् ।
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च जानीयामिति सत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: "I practiced very great, supremely harsh austerity, so that I might know past, present, and future, good men.

verses.text:
तस्य मे तप्ततपसो निगृहीतेन्द्रियस्य च ।
नारायणप्रसादेन क्षीरोदस्यानुकूलतः ॥

meaning.en: By Narayana's grace, near the Ocean of Milk, to me, practicing austerity with senses restrained,

verses.text:
त्रैकालिकमिदं ज्ञानं प्रादुर्भूतं यथेप्सितम् ।
तच्छृणुध्वं यथाज्ञानं वक्ष्ये संशयमुत्तमम् ।
यथा वृत्तं हि कल्पादौ दृष्टं मे ज्ञानचक्षुषा ॥

meaning.en: this knowledge of the three times arose as I wished. Hear it as I have understood it; I will explain the excellent doubt. I saw with the eye of knowledge how things were at the start of the age.

verses.text:
परमात्मेति यं प्राहुः सांख्ययोगविदो जनाः ।
महापुरुषसंज्ञां स लभते स्वेन कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: The one whom those who know Sankhya and Yoga call the supreme Self gains the name of the great Person by his own action.

verses.text:
तस्मात्प्रसूतमव्यक्तं प्रधानं तद्विदुर्बुधाः ।
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तमुत्पन्नं लोकसृष्ट्यर्थमीश्वरात् ॥

meaning.en: From that the unmanifest, the primal matter, was born, as the wise know. From the unmanifest, the manifest arose from the Lord for the creation of the world.

verses.text:
अनिरुद्धो हि लोकेषु महानात्मेति कथ्यते ।
योऽसौ व्यक्तत्वमापन्नो निर्ममे च पितामहम् ।
सोऽहंकार इति प्रोक्तः सर्वतेजोमयो हि सः ॥

meaning.en: Aniruddha is called the great Self among the worlds; he who attained manifestation and created the Grandfather is called egoity, made wholly of splendor.

verses.text:
पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् ।
अहंकारप्रसूतानि महाभूतानि भारत ॥

meaning.en: Earth, wind, space, water, and fire as the fifth: the great elements, Bharata, are born from egoity.

verses.text:
महाभूतानि सृष्ट्वाथ तद्गुणान्निर्ममे पुनः ।
भूतेभ्यश्चैव निष्पन्ना मूर्तिमन्तोऽष्ट ताञ्शृणु ॥

meaning.en: Having made the great elements, he then made their qualities; hear the eight embodied ones produced from the elements.

verses.text:
मरीचिरङ्गिराश्चात्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः ।
वसिष्ठश्च महात्मा वै मनुः स्वायंभुवस्तथा ।
ज्ञेयाः प्रकृतयोऽष्टौ ता यासु लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥

meaning.en: Marichi, Angiras, Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, the great-souled Vasishtha, and Manu Svayambhuva: these are to be known as the eight primal sources in which the worlds are established.

verses.text:
वेदान्वेदाङ्गसंयुक्तान्यज्ञान्यज्ञाङ्गसंयुतान् ।
निर्ममे लोकसिद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ।
अष्टाभ्यः प्रकृतिभ्यश्च जातं विश्वमिदं जगत् ॥

meaning.en: Brahma, grandfather of the world, made the Vedas with their limbs and the sacrifices with their limbs for the success of the world. From the eight primal sources this whole world was born.

verses.text:
रुद्रो रोषात्मको जातो दशान्यान्सोऽसृजत्स्वयम् ।
एकादशैते रुद्रास्तु विकाराः पुरुषाः स्मृताः ॥

meaning.en: Rudra, whose nature is anger, was born and himself created ten others; these are the eleven Rudras, remembered as modifications, persons.

verses.text:
ते रुद्राः प्रकृतिश्चैव सर्वे चैव सुरर्षयः ।
उत्पन्ना लोकसिद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्माणं समुपस्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: Those Rudras, the primal sources, and all the divine sages, born for the success of the worlds, approached Brahma.

verses.text:
वयं हि सृष्टा भगवंस्त्वया वै प्रभविष्णुना ।
येन यस्मिन्नधीकारे वर्तितव्यं पितामह ॥

meaning.en: 'Blessed one, we were created by you, the powerful; tell us, Grandfather, by whom and in what office we are to act.

verses.text:
योऽसौ त्वया विनिर्दिष्टो अधिकारोऽर्थचिन्तकः ।
परिपाल्यः कथं तेन सोऽधिकारोऽधिकारिणा ॥

meaning.en: The office you have assigned, how should that officeholder guard it, considering its purpose?

verses.text:
प्रदिशस्व बलं तस्य योऽधिकारार्थचिन्तकः ।
एवमुक्तो महादेवो देवांस्तानिदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Grant strength to the one who attends to that office's aim.' So addressed, Mahadeva said to those gods:

verses.text:
साध्वहं ज्ञापितो देवा युष्माभिर्भद्रमस्तु वः ।
ममाप्येषा समुत्पन्ना चिन्ता या भवतां मता ॥

meaning.en: 'Good, gods, you have made me aware; blessings on you. This same concern that you hold has arisen in me too.

verses.text:
लोकतन्त्रस्य कृत्स्नस्य कथं कार्यः परिग्रहः ।
कथं बलक्षयो न स्याद्युष्माकं ह्यात्मनश्च मे ॥

meaning.en: How is the whole system of the world to be taken up, and how may your strength and mine not be depleted?

verses.text:
इतः सर्वेऽपि गच्छामः शरणं लोकसाक्षिणम् ।
महापुरुषमव्यक्तं स नो वक्ष्यति यद्धितम् ॥

meaning.en: Let us all go from here for refuge to the witness of the worlds, the unmanifest great Person; he will tell us what is beneficial.'

verses.text:
ततस्ते ब्रह्मणा सार्धमृषयो विबुधास्तथा ।
क्षीरोदस्योत्तरं कूलं जग्मुर्लोकहितार्थिनः ॥

meaning.en: Then those sages and gods, together with Brahma, went to the northern shore of the Ocean of Milk, seeking the welfare of the worlds.

verses.text:
ते तपः समुपातिष्ठन्ब्रह्मोक्तं वेदकल्पितम् ।
स महानियमो नाम तपश्चर्या सुदारुणा ॥

meaning.en: They undertook the austerity taught by Brahma and shaped by the Veda, the very harsh practice called the Great Observance.

verses.text:
ऊर्ध्वं दृष्टिर्बाहवश्च एकाग्रं च मनोऽभवत् ।
एकपादस्थिताः सम्यक्काष्ठभूताः समाहिताः ॥

meaning.en: With eyes and arms upward, with one-pointed minds, standing on one foot, concentrated and still as wood,

verses.text:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं ते तपस्तप्त्वा तदुत्तमम् ।
शुश्रुवुर्मधुरां वाणीं वेदवेदाङ्गभूषिताम् ॥

meaning.en: having practiced that excellent austerity for a divine thousand years, they heard a sweet voice adorned with the Vedas and their limbs.

verses.text:
भो भोः सब्रह्मका देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः ।
स्वागतेनार्च्य वः सर्वाञ्श्रावये वाक्यमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Hey, gods with Brahma and sages rich in austerity! Welcoming you all, I speak an excellent word.

verses.text:
विज्ञातं वो मया कार्यं तच्च लोकहितं महत् ।
प्रवृत्तियुक्तं कर्तव्यं युष्मत्प्राणोपबृंहणम् ॥

meaning.en: I know your purpose and it is a great one for the world's welfare: an act of engagement is to be performed, strengthening your life-breaths.

verses.text:
सुतप्तं वस्तपो देवा ममाराधनकाम्यया ।
भोक्ष्यथास्य महासत्त्वास्तपसः फलमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Your austerity, gods, was well practiced from desire to propitiate me; mighty ones, you will enjoy the excellent fruit of this austerity.

verses.text:
एष ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुः सर्वलोकपितामहः ।
यूयं च विबुधश्रेष्ठा मां यजध्वं समाहिताः ॥

meaning.en: Here is Brahma, teacher of the worlds, grandfather of all the worlds; and you, best of gods, worship me with concentration.

verses.text:
सर्वे भागान्कल्पयध्वं यज्ञेषु मम नित्यशः ।
तथा श्रेयो विधास्यामि यथाधीकारमीश्वराः ॥

meaning.en: All of you, assign me shares in sacrifices always; and I will bring about good as befits each one's office, lords.'

verses.text:
श्रुत्वैतद्देवदेवस्य वाक्यं हृष्टतनूरुहाः ।
ततस्ते विबुधाः सर्वे ब्रह्मा ते च महर्षयः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this word of the god of gods, with hair standing on end, all those gods, Brahma, and those great sages

verses.text:
वेददृष्टेन विधिना वैष्णवं क्रतुमाहरन् ।
तस्मिन्सत्रे तदा ब्रह्मा स्वयं भागमकल्पयत् ।
देवा देवर्षयश्चैव सर्वे भागानकल्पयन् ॥

meaning.en: performed the Vishnu sacrifice by the rite seen in the Veda. In that session Brahma himself assigned a share, and all the gods and divine sages assigned shares.

verses.text:
ते कार्तयुगधर्माणो भागाः परमसत्कृताः ।
प्रापुरादित्यवर्णं तं पुरुषं तमसः परम् ।
बृहन्तं सर्वगं देवमीशानं वरदं प्रभुम् ॥

meaning.en: Those shares, in the manner of the Krita age, highly honored, reached the Person, sun-colored, beyond darkness, vast, all-pervading, god, ruler, boon-giver, lord.

verses.text:
ततोऽथ वरदो देवस्तान्सर्वानमरान्स्थितान् ।
अशरीरो बभाषेदं वाक्यं खस्थो महेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Then the boon-giving god, bodiless and in the sky, the great Lord, spoke these words to all those immortals standing there:

verses.text:
येन यः कल्पितो भागः स तथा समुपागतः ।
प्रीतोऽहं प्रदिशाम्यद्य फलमावृत्तिलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: 'The share each assigned has reached me accordingly. Pleased, I now grant the fruit that has the mark of return.

verses.text:
एतद्वो लक्षणं देवा मत्प्रसादसमुद्भवम् ।
यूयं यज्ञैरिज्यमानाः समाप्तवरदक्षिणैः ।
युगे युगे भविष्यध्वं प्रवृत्तिफलभोगिनः ॥

meaning.en: This is your mark, gods, born from my grace: honored with sacrifices completed with abundant gifts, in every age you will be enjoyers of the fruit of engagement.

verses.text:
यज्ञैर्ये चापि यक्ष्यन्ति सर्वलोकेषु वै सुराः ।
कल्पयिष्यन्ति वो भागांस्ते नरा वेदकल्पितान् ॥

meaning.en: And those who in all the worlds, gods, will sacrifice with sacrifices, those men will assign you the shares fixed by the Veda.

verses.text:
यो मे यथा कल्पितवान्भागमस्मिन्महाक्रतौ ।
स तथा यज्ञभागार्हो वेदसूत्रे मया कृतः ॥

meaning.en: Whoever assigns me a share in this great sacrifice, he is by me made fit for a sacrificial share according to the Vedic code.

verses.text:
यूयं लोकान्धारयध्वं यज्ञभागफलोदिताः ।
सर्वार्थचिन्तका लोके यथाधीकारनिर्मिताः ॥

meaning.en: You uphold the worlds, flourishing by the fruit of sacrificial shares, thinking of all purposes in the world and made according to your offices.

verses.text:
याः क्रियाः प्रचरिष्यन्ति प्रवृत्तिफलसत्कृताः ।
ताभिराप्यायितबला लोकान्वै धारयिष्यथ ॥

meaning.en: By the rites that will be performed, honored with the fruit of engagement, you will be strengthened and so uphold the worlds.

verses.text:
यूयं हि भाविता लोके सर्वयज्ञेषु मानवैः ।
मां ततो भावयिष्यध्वमेषा वो भावना मम ॥

meaning.en: You will be nourished in the world by men at all sacrifices; then you will nourish me. This is your nourishing of me.

verses.text:
इत्यर्थं निर्मिता वेदा यज्ञाश्चौषधिभिः सह ।
एभिः सम्यक्प्रयुक्तैर्हि प्रीयन्ते देवताः क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: For this purpose the Vedas and the sacrifices with herbs were created; when these are correctly used, the gods on earth are pleased.

verses.text:
निर्माणमेतद्युष्माकं प्रवृत्तिगुणकल्पितम् ।
मया कृतं सुरश्रेष्ठा यावत्कल्पक्षयादिति ।
चिन्तयध्वं लोकहितं यथाधीकारमीश्वराः ॥

meaning.en: This arrangement for you, made of the quality of engagement, I have made, best of gods, until the end of the age; think of the welfare of the world, lords, according to your offices.

verses.text:
मरीचिरङ्गिराश्चात्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः ।
वसिष्ठ इति सप्तैते मानसा निर्मिता हि वै ॥

meaning.en: Marichi, Angiras, Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, and Vasishtha: these seven were created from my mind.

verses.text:
एते वेदविदो मुख्या वेदाचार्याश्च कल्पिताः ।
प्रवृत्तिधर्मिणश्चैव प्राजापत्येन कल्पिताः ॥

meaning.en: These are the chief knowers of the Veda, made teachers of the Veda, and were established by Prajapati's rule as followers of the dharma of engagement.

verses.text:
अयं क्रियावतां पन्था व्यक्तीभूतः सनातनः ।
अनिरुद्ध इति प्रोक्तो लोकसर्गकरः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: This eternal path of those who perform rites has become manifest; the lord who creates the world is called Aniruddha.

verses.text:
सनः सनत्सुजातश्च सनकः ससनन्दनः ।
सनत्कुमारः कपिलः सप्तमश्च सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: Sana, Sanatsujata, Sanaka with Sananda, Sanatkumara, Kapila, and Sanatana as the seventh:

verses.text:
सप्तैते मानसाः प्रोक्ता ऋषयो ब्रह्मणः सुताः ।
स्वयमागतविज्ञाना निवृत्तं धर्ममास्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: these seven are called mind-born sages, Brahma's sons, who attained knowledge on their own and abide in the dharma of withdrawal.

verses.text:
एते योगविदो मुख्याः सांख्यधर्मविदस्तथा ।
आचार्या मोक्षशास्त्रे च मोक्षधर्मप्रवर्तकाः ॥

meaning.en: These are the chief knowers of yoga and of the dharma of Sankhya, teachers in the science of liberation and promoters of the dharma of liberation.

verses.text:
यतोऽहं प्रसृतः पूर्वमव्यक्तात्त्रिगुणो महान् ।
तस्मात्परतरो योऽसौ क्षेत्रज्ञ इति कल्पितः ।
सोऽहं क्रियावतां पन्थाः पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभः ॥

meaning.en: From the unmanifest I first emerged, the great one with three qualities; he who is beyond that, conceived as the knower of the field, I am that; I am the path of those who perform rites, hard to return from.

verses.text:
यो यथा निर्मितो जन्तुर्यस्मिन्यस्मिंश्च कर्मणि ।
प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा तत्फलं सोऽश्नुतेऽवशः ॥

meaning.en: However a creature was made and in whatever action, whether engagement or withdrawal, he helplessly enjoys its fruit.

verses.text:
एष लोकगुरुर्ब्रह्मा जगदादिकरः प्रभुः ।
एष माता पिता चैव युष्माकं च पितामहः ।
मयानुशिष्टो भविता सर्वभूतवरप्रदः ॥

meaning.en: This is Brahma, teacher of the worlds, lord, the first maker of the world; he is mother and father to you, and your grandfather, and instructed by me he will be the boon-giver to all beings.

verses.text:
अस्य चैवानुजो रुद्रो ललाटाद्यः समुत्थितः ।
ब्रह्मानुशिष्टो भविता सर्वत्रसवरप्रदः ॥

meaning.en: His younger brother Rudra, who sprang from his forehead, instructed by Brahma, will be a boon-giver everywhere.

verses.text:
गच्छध्वं स्वानधीकारांश्चिन्तयध्वं यथाविधि ।
प्रवर्तन्तां क्रियाः सर्वाः सर्वलोकेषु माचिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Go to your own offices and consider them properly; let all rites be set in motion in all the worlds without delay.

verses.text:
प्रदृश्यन्तां च कर्माणि प्राणिनां गतयस्तथा ।
परिनिर्मितकालानि आयूंषि च सुरोत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: Let the deeds of beings be seen, and their destinations, and their lifespans fixed in time, best of gods.

verses.text:
इदं कृतयुगं नाम कालः श्रेष्ठः प्रवर्तते ।
अहिंस्या यज्ञपशवो युगेऽस्मिन्नैतदन्यथा ।
चतुष्पात्सकलो धर्मो भविष्यत्यत्र वै सुराः ॥

meaning.en: This age called Krita, the best time, is now underway. In this age sacrificial animals are not to be harmed, not otherwise, and dharma will be complete here on four feet, gods.

verses.text:
ततस्त्रेतायुगं नाम त्रयी यत्र भविष्यति ।
प्रोक्षिता यत्र पशवो वधं प्राप्स्यन्ति वै मखे ।
तत्र पादचतुर्थो वै धर्मस्य न भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Then will come the age called Treta, in which the triple Veda will be; there animals, sprinkled, will be killed in sacrifice; there a fourth part of dharma will be missing.

verses.text:
ततो वै द्वापरं नाम मिश्रः कालो भविष्यति ।
द्विपादहीनो धर्मश्च युगे तस्मिन्भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Then will come the age called Dvapara, a mixed time; in that age dharma will lack two feet.

verses.text:
ततस्तिष्येऽथ संप्राप्ते युगे कलिपुरस्कृते ।
एकपादस्थितो धर्मो यत्र तत्र भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Then, when the Tishya age arrives, led by Kali, dharma will stand on one foot, wherever it is."

verses.text: देवा ऊचुः

meaning.en: The gods said:

verses.text:
एकपादस्थिते धर्मे यत्रक्वचनगामिनि ।
कथं कर्तव्यमस्माभिर्भगवंस्तद्वदस्व नः ॥

meaning.en: "When dharma stands on one foot and goes anywhere it likes, what should we do then, Lord? Tell us."

verses.text: श्रीभगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The Blessed One said:

verses.text:
यत्र वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च तपः सत्यं दमस्तथा ।
अहिंसाधर्मसंयुक्ताः प्रचरेयुः सुरोत्तमाः ।
स वै देशः सेवितव्यो मा वोऽधर्मः पदा स्पृशेत् ॥

meaning.en: "Where the Vedas, sacrifices, austerity, truth, and self-restraint, joined with the dharma of nonviolence, are practiced, best of gods, that is the region to be resorted to, so that adharma does not touch you with its foot."

verses.text: व्यास उवाच

meaning.en: Vyasa said:

verses.text:
तेऽनुशिष्टा भगवता देवाः सर्षिगणास्तथा ।
नमस्कृत्वा भगवते जग्मुर्देशान्यथेप्सितान् ॥

meaning.en: Instructed by the Blessed One, those gods with the groups of sages bowed to the Blessed One and went to the regions they wished.

verses.text:
गतेषु त्रिदिवौकःसु ब्रह्मैकः पर्यवस्थितः ।
दिदृक्षुर्भगवन्तं तमनिरुद्धतनौ स्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: When the dwellers of heaven had gone, Brahma alone remained, wishing to see that Blessed One abiding in the body of Aniruddha.

verses.text:
तं देवो दर्शयामास कृत्वा हयशिरो महत् ।
साङ्गानावर्तयन्वेदान्कमण्डलुगणित्रधृक् ॥

meaning.en: The god showed himself to him, making a great horse-head, reciting the Vedas with their limbs, bearing a water pot and a rosary.

verses.text:
ततोऽश्वशिरसं दृष्ट्वा तं देवममितौजसम् ।
लोककर्ता प्रभुर्ब्रह्मा लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥

meaning.en: Then, seeing that god of boundless might with the horse head, the world-maker, lord Brahma, wishing the good of the worlds,

verses.text:
मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य वरदं तस्थौ प्राञ्जलिरग्रतः ।
स परिष्वज्य देवेन वचनं श्रावितस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: bowed his head to the boon-giver and stood before him with folded hands. Embraced by the god, he was then told these words:

verses.text:
लोककार्यगतीः सर्वास्त्वं चिन्तय यथाविधि ।
धाता त्वं सर्वभूतानां त्वं प्रभुर्जगतो गुरुः ।
त्वय्यावेशितभारोऽहं धृतिं प्राप्स्याम्यथाञ्जसा ॥

meaning.en: "Think properly of all the courses of worldly action. You are the sustainer of all beings, you the lord, the teacher of the world. With the burden laid on you, I will gain firmness at once.

verses.text:
यदा च सुरकार्यं ते अविषह्यं भविष्यति ।
प्रादुर्भावं गमिष्यामि तदात्मज्ञानदेशिकः ॥

meaning.en: And when the gods' task becomes too hard for you, I will come into manifestation as a teacher of self-knowledge."

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा हयशिरास्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।
तेनानुशिष्टो ब्रह्मापि स्वं लोकमचिराद्गतः ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, Hayashiras vanished right there; and Brahma, instructed by him, soon went to his own world.

verses.text:
एवमेष महाभागः पद्मनाभः सनातनः ।
यज्ञेष्वग्रहरः प्रोक्तो यज्ञधारी च नित्यदा ॥

meaning.en: Thus this greatly fortunate, eternal Padmanabha is called the first taker of the share in sacrifices and the constant bearer of sacrifice.

verses.text:
निवृत्तिं चास्थितो धर्मं गतिमक्षयधर्मिणाम् ।
प्रवृत्तिधर्मान्विदधे कृत्वा लोकस्य चित्रताम् ॥

meaning.en: Established in the dharma of withdrawal, the goal of those with imperishable dharma, he ordained the dharmas of engagement, making the world varied.

verses.text:
स आदिः स मध्यः स चान्तः प्रजानां
स धाता स धेयः स कर्ता स कार्यम् ।
युगान्ते स सुप्तः सुसंक्षिप्य लोका-
न्युगादौ प्रबुद्धो जगद्ध्युत्ससर्ज ॥

meaning.en: He is the beginning, middle, and end of beings; he is the sustainer, the sustained, the doer, the deed. Sleeping at the end of the age, having drawn in the worlds, awakened at the start of the age he released the world.

verses.text:
तस्मै नमध्वं देवाय निर्गुणाय गुणात्मने ।
अजाय विश्वरूपाय धाम्ने सर्वदिवौकसाम् ॥

meaning.en: Bow to that god, quality-free yet the self of qualities, unborn, of universal form, the abode of all heavenly beings;

verses.text:
महाभूताधिपतये रुद्राणां पतये तथा ।
आदित्यपतये चैव वसूनां पतये तथा ॥

meaning.en: to the lord of the great elements, the lord of the Rudras, the lord of the Adityas, and the lord of the Vasus,

verses.text:
अश्विभ्यां पतये चैव मरुतां पतये तथा ।
वेदयज्ञाधिपतये वेदाङ्गपतयेऽपि च ॥

meaning.en: the lord of the two Ashvins, the lord of the Maruts, the lord of the Vedas and sacrifices, and the lord of the limbs of the Veda too;

verses.text:
समुद्रवासिने नित्यं हरये मुञ्जकेशिने ।
शान्तये सर्वभूतानां मोक्षधर्मानुभाषिणे ॥

meaning.en: to Hari, who ever dwells in the ocean, with hair of munja grass, peace of all beings, the speaker of the dharma of liberation;

verses.text:
तपसां तेजसां चैव पतये यशसोऽपि च ।
वाचश्च पतये नित्यं सरितां पतये तथा ॥

meaning.en: to the lord of austerities and radiances and fame, the lord of speech always, the lord of rivers;

verses.text:
कपर्दिने वराहाय एकशृङ्गाय धीमते ।
विवस्वतेऽश्वशिरसे चतुर्मूर्तिधृते सदा ॥

meaning.en: to Kapardin, to the Boar, to the one-horned wise one, to Vivasvan, to Hayashiras, always bearing the four forms;

verses.text:
गुह्याय ज्ञानदृश्याय अक्षराय क्षराय च ।
एष देवः संचरति सर्वत्रगतिरव्ययः ॥

meaning.en: to the secret one, seen by knowledge, the imperishable and the perishable. This god moves everywhere, imperishable, going all ways.

verses.text:
एवमेतत्पुरा दृष्टं मया वै ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
कथितं तच्च वः सर्वं मया पृष्टेन तत्त्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Thus I saw this long ago with the eye of knowledge, and I have told you all of it truly because you asked me.

verses.text:
क्रियतां मद्वचः शिष्याः सेव्यतां हरिरीश्वरः ।
गीयतां वेदशब्दैश्च पूज्यतां च यथाविधि ॥

meaning.en: Do as I say, pupils: serve Hari the Lord, sing him with Vedic words, and worship him according to rule."

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्तास्तु वयं तेन वेदव्यासेन धीमता ।
सर्वे शिष्याः सुतश्चास्य शुकः परमधर्मवित् ॥

meaning.en: So instructed by the wise Vedavyasa, we all, his pupils, and his son Shuka, who knew the highest dharma,

verses.text:
स चास्माकमुपाध्यायः सहास्माभिर्विशां पते ।
चतुर्वेदोद्गताभिश्च ऋग्भिस्तमभितुष्टुवे ॥

meaning.en: and he, our teacher, together with us, lord of men, praised him with verses drawn from the four Vedas.

verses.text:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ।
एवं मेऽकथयद्राजन्पुरा द्वैपायनो गुरुः ॥

meaning.en: All this that you asked me has been told to you. So, king, my teacher Dvaipayana told me long ago.

verses.text:
यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं यश्चेदं परिकीर्तयेत् ।
नमो भगवते कृत्वा समाहितमना नरः ॥

meaning.en: Whoever constantly hears this or recites it, bowing to the Blessed One with a concentrated mind,

verses.text:
भवत्यरोगो द्युतिमान्बलरूपसमन्वितः ।
आतुरो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् ॥

meaning.en: becomes free of disease, radiant, endowed with strength and beauty; the sick are freed from illness and the bound from bondage.

verses.text:
कामकामी लभेत्कामं दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयात् ।
ब्राह्मणः सर्ववेदी स्यात्क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् ।
वैश्यो विपुललाभः स्याच्छूद्रः सुखमवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: One who desires a wish gets it and gains a long life; a brahmin becomes master of all the Vedas, a kshatriya victorious, a vaishya rich in profit, a shudra gains happiness.

verses.text:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं कन्या चैवेप्सितं पतिम् ।
लग्नगर्भा विमुच्येत गर्भिणी जनयेत्सुतम् ।
वन्ध्या प्रसवमाप्नोति पुत्रपौत्रसमृद्धिमत् ॥

meaning.en: The childless gains a son, a maiden the husband she wishes, a woman with an attached womb is freed, a pregnant woman bears a son, a barren woman gives birth to one rich in sons and grandsons.

verses.text:
क्षेमेण गच्छेदध्वानमिदं यः पठते पथि ।
यो यं कामं कामयते स तमाप्नोति च ध्रुवम् ॥

meaning.en: One who reads this on the road goes his way safely; whoever desires any wish certainly obtains it.

verses.text:
इदं महर्षेर्वचनं विनिश्चितं
महात्मनः पुरुषवरस्य कीर्तनम् ।
समागमं चर्षिदिवौकसामिमं
निशम्य भक्ताः सुसुखं लभन्ते ॥

meaning.en: This is the settled word of the great sage, the praise of the great-souled best of Persons; hearing of this meeting of sages and heavenly beings, devotees gain great happiness.
